name: version-reuse-after-rollback
why: A kill -9 of the owner rolls the database back to its last published generation (inside the RPO), and counting on from the restored numbers issued the lost writes' _version numbers again for other contents. A bank transfer computed before the crash (read at versions v, patch absolute balances with expect {version: v}) that was still in flight or retried with its request id after the restart then passed its expect against the new, different document at the same version and wrote stale balances: the bank summed to 398, not 400. Fixed by the version floor (docexec.VersionFloor: a write sets max(prev+1, seal<<32), and the manifest's seal no longer restarts with a generation). Shrunk from swarm seed 2761 to three kill/restart pairs of vm2.
